--CREATING SCHEMA
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM sys.schemas WHERE name='gold')
BEGIN
    EXECUTE('CREATE SCHEMA gold')
END;

--CREATING EXTERNAL TABLE
IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM sys.external_tables t LEFT JOIN sys.schemas s ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id WHERE t.name = 'sales' AND s.name = 'gold')
BEGIN
    EXECUTE(
        '
            CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE gold.sales
            (
                Outlet_Establishment_Year INT,
                Outlet_Location_Type VARCHAR(100),
                Total_Sales DECIMAL(15,2)
            )
            WITH
            (
                LOCATION = ''github/data/**'',
                DATA_SOURCE = [gold_source],
                FILE_FORMAT = [delta_format]
            )
        '
    )
END;
